content.text:
Done. The change is in your `~/.tmux.conf`:

```
set -g mouse on
set -g extended-keys on
```

You'll need to reload tmux from within your active session for this to take effect:
- Type `Ctrl+b` then `:` (colon) to open the tmux command prompt
- Type `source-file ~/.tmux.conf` and press Enter

This enables full mouse support in tmux, which makes the mouse wheel scroll through the terminal output buffer instead of triggering other behaviors.
